messages:
Ava M: Draft uploaded — blog draft #3 is in the Google doc: https://docs.google.com/.. Please do a quick pass on the hero claim + CTA. Need approvals by EOD Friday. Also mapping to webinar registration (May 6).

Ravi K: quick q — benchmark callout uses '50% latency improvement' where did that stat come from? need source for legal.

Liam P: That stat came from internal perf run on r-infer 2.1 vs baseline. I'll paste the test id in a sec.

Liam P: test id: perf-run-2026-04-05-03. Summary: median p95 latency down 52%, qps stable. Recommend we phrase as '~50% median latency reduction' or cite internal benchmark.

Sofia G: also need localized hero for FR/DE/JP. Can we lock copy by Thurs so localization starts?

Chris L: Legal - flagging 'reduction' claims. We need the test method + environment in an appendix or 'how we measured' link. Also avoid absolutes like 'guaranteed'.

Ava M: Good call. Liam, can you add a 2-3 sentence methods blurb to the doc and link to the perf run artifact? I'll add a 'how we measured' anchor.

Liam P: added to doc, section 'Measurement notes' with link to artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/prof/perf-run-2026-04-05

Ava M: CTA options in doc: `Get started — Free sandbox` vs `Join the demo — Limited seats` — preference?

Sofia G: For webinar routing, prefer `Join the demo` with seat cap. We need to wire the registration to HubSpot list: `launch-webinar-may6`.

registrations-bot: Note: provisional webinar capacity set to 200. If we need overflow, enable waitlist tag `launch-webinar-waitlist`.

Ava M: Can someone confirm the HubSpot tag and whether there's a webinar landing variant with localized copy?

Ravi K: I'll sync with ops. HubSpot tag exists. For variants, we should A/B test header copy — english canonical vs benefit-led. Ops can route leads to appropriate nurture sequence.

Chris L: Legal OK on tentative language after adding methods. Remove 'guaranteed' and change 'improvement' to 'reduction' per style.

Sofia G: Localization note — translator lead @Luca is OOO Thurs-Fri. If we lock copy by Wed end, we might miss JP. Suggest we push JP to second wave.

Ava M: New timeline: lock by Wed EOD for EN/FR/DE. JP in wave 2. Webinar registration link goes live Thu AM. Can marketing ops confirm seat mapping + HubSpot list by Wed noon?

registrations-bot: Calendar update: webinar draft scheduled May 6 10am PT. Registration URL will be /events/launch-may6 once published.

Liam P: small nit — hero headline in doc currently: `Faster inference for production` -> propose `Faster, cheaper inference for production at scale` (still short).

Ava M: love it. I'll update headline. Thanks team — ping me if legal needs a change. :rocket:
